CustomField.formula:
LEFT( LicensePeriod__c , 2) + "/" +
LEFT( MID(LicensePeriod__c, 3, LEN(LicensePeriod__c)) , 2) + " - " +
LEFT( MID(LicensePeriod__c, 5, LEN(LicensePeriod__c)) , 2) + "/" +
LEFT( MID(LicensePeriod__c, 7, LEN(LicensePeriod__c)) , 2)
CustomField.label: Renewal Cycle License Period
